# Asset sources

- KGP building: generated with the built-in image generator from the user's provided building photograph. Prompt: isolated flat illustrated IIT Kharagpur building, retaining tower, cream colonnaded facade and terracotta entrance; transparent background; no garden, road, trees, sky or statue.
- Flipkart: https://static-assets-web.flixcart.com/apex-static/images/fk-lite-assets/app-icons/app-icon_192x192.png
- Adobe: https://get.adobe.com/reader/afe53b9/images/adobe_logo_header.svg
- GitHub: https://github.githubassets.com/favicons/favicon.svg
- Onehouse: https://www.onehouse.ai/favicon.png

Company marks identify former employers; the site is a personal portfolio.

Fonts are served locally from assets/fonts to avoid external render-blocking requests. DM Sans and Noto Sans Devanagari WOFF2 subsets were obtained from Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com); their SIL Open Font License files are included alongside the fonts. Display-only WebP derivatives are used for the KGP icon and gallery previews; full-resolution gallery originals are unchanged.
